description: On the table in front, there’s a gray plastic tub, a small yellow cup filled with ice cubes to the left of it, and a purple scoop on the right. The left hand reaches toward the yellow cup, grips it as a left-hand object, lifts and tilts it over the gray tub to dump the ice cubes inside, then lowers and releases the cup back onto the table while the right hand stays near the tub without touching anything.
